description: ENIGMA ST7 v1.2 P/LP missense references accepted for protein-level PS1, plus separately verified VCEP references from curated extensions. The reference and assessed-variant SpliceAI scores are computed on demand.

rule_source.name: ClinGen ENIGMA BRCA1/2 VCEP PS1 specification

candidate_source.name: ClinGen ENIGMA BRCA1/2 VCEP Supplementary Table 7

methodological_decision.decision: A Pathogenic or Likely Pathogenic IARC classification in ENIGMA Supplementary Table 7 v1.2 satisfies the PS1 requirement that the reference classification was assigned using VCEP specifications.
methodological_decision.scope: This decision establishes only the reference classification basis. All protein-level PS1 identity, mechanism, splice and runtime SpliceAI requirements remain mandatory.

classification_policy: Official ENIGMA ST7 v1.2 P/LP records are accepted as the reference classification basis for protein-level PS1 following expert methodological review on 2026-09-07. Automatic scoring still requires a matching missense consequence caused by a different nucleotide change, an eligible protein mechanism, SpliceAI <= 0.1 for both variants and no damaging splice evidence in the defined sources.

accepted_classification_bases.use: Accepted P/LP reference classification basis. Automatic PS1 remains conditional on identity, mechanism and splice checks.

accepted_classification_bases.source: Versioned ENIGMA/ClinGen VCEP assertion, normally ClinGen Evidence Repository or a ClinVar expert-panel assertion
accepted_classification_bases.use: May enter through the curated extension file after identity, transcript, mechanism, splice and provenance validation.

accepted_classification_bases.source: Documented local reclassification under a named ENIGMA VCEP specification version
accepted_classification_bases.use: May enter through the curated extension file; it must not be labelled as an official expert-panel assertion.

discovery_only_not_sufficient_for_eligib: ClinVar record without an ENIGMA/ClinGen expert-panel assertion
individual publication without a complete VCEP classification record
supporting_and_exclusion_sources: versioned SpliceAI result with reference genome, transcript and model provenance
canonical RefSeq transcript and normalized protein consequence
